description:
𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐧, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐤 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝!

Did an arrangement of Seija Kijin's theme from Touhou 14: Double Dealing Character, Reverse Ideology, for C3 Winter 2022. Easily one of my favorite boss themes in the series and kinda reminds me of Castlevania.

♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.
